in_marathi.name: Vikaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory, Command, Rule
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vikram means 'victory' and 'command'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vikramana' which means 'ruler' or 'conqueror'.

in_bengali.name: Vikaram

in_bengali.long_meaning: Vikaram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vikram means 'victory' and 'command'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vikramana' which means 'ruler' or 'conqueror'.
